name: File Analyzer
description: Identify the file type, extract magic bytes and a digest to verify a downloaded file.

hints.data: The file is supplied as Base64.
hints.output: Detection uses a built-in magic byte snapshot; the system MIME database is never read and nothing is fetched.

faq.q: Can the digest verify a download?
faq.a: Yes, compare it with the checksum published by the source.

faq.q: What if the type is not recognised?
faq.a: It falls back to application/octet-stream with a bin extension.
